providers.name: GitHub
providers.purpose: Source control, issues, pull requests, commits, proof memory, and Actions workflows.
providers.runtime_effect: Repo creation and proof can proceed.
providers.fallback: Local Git repository if GitHub unavailable.
providers.health_check: repository reachable and write permission available

providers.name: Oracle Free / Oracle Lite
providers.purpose: First constrained runtime for production-like deployment.
providers.runtime_effect: Deployment disabled until VM/environment is configured.
providers.candidate_visible_effect: No public production service until deployed.
providers.fallback: Local Docker runtime and GitHub proof.
providers.health_check: VM reachable, Docker running, services healthy, backups configured

providers.name: PostgreSQL
providers.runtime_effect: API runtime cannot store real candidate/source/payment/application truth until configured.
providers.fallback: Static proof, test fixtures, or local development database.

providers.name: Redis
providers.purpose: Queue, locks, rate limits, and lightweight worker coordination.
providers.runtime_effect: Worker queue and throttling disabled until configured.
providers.candidate_visible_effect: Long-running jobs may be disabled or manual.

providers.name: SMTP / Email Provider
providers.runtime_effect: Real outbound email disabled; Mailpit/local proof only.
providers.candidate_visible_effect: UI must show email pending, not sent.
providers.fallback: Mailpit/local capture or portal continuation instructions.
providers.health_check: SMTP connection and test outbox proof

providers.name: Payment Provider
providers.purpose: Hosted payment flow for packages and CV Revamp.
providers.runtime_effect: Real payment disabled; sandbox/manual proof only.
providers.candidate_visible_effect: No real payment claim may be shown.
providers.health_check: sandbox payment verification and webhook proof

providers.name: Object Storage
providers.purpose: Document Vault and evidence storage using signed upload URLs.
providers.runtime_effect: Real document upload disabled until configured.
providers.candidate_visible_effect: Document upload must be unavailable or marked test-only.

providers.name: OpenClaw Gateway
providers.purpose: Governed remote operator gateway after reports, validators, and Control Plane exist.
providers.runtime_effect: No OpenClaw actions run while paused/not configured.
providers.fallback: ChatGPT, GitHub, and manual PowerShell operation.
providers.health_check: gateway reachable and permission policy enforced

providers.name: WhatsApp Provider
providers.purpose: Urgent-only/ceremonial templates later; not bulk routine reminders.
providers.runtime_effect: WhatsApp unavailable until configured and approved.

providers.name: SMS Provider
providers.runtime_effect: SMS unavailable until configured and justified.
providers.health_check: test backup SMS and cost guard

providers.name: Mailpit
providers.runtime_effect: Email templates can be tested locally once configured.
